description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the single available game: lobster-cli-roguelike. 2. Agent lists ONLY the two supported platforms (linux-x86_64 and darwin-arm64) — must NOT claim Windows or darwin-x86_64 are supported. 3. Agent provides exact asset filenames: 'lobster-cli-roguelike-linux-x86_64.tar.gz' and 'lobster-cli-roguelike-darwin-arm64.tar.gz'. 4. Agent links to 'https://github.com/Arcobalneo/gameclaw/releases/latest'. 5. Agent provides correct Linux unpack/run commands: 'tar -xzf lobster-cli-roguelike-linux-x86_64.tar.gz', 'cd lobster-cli-roguelike-linux-x86_64', './lobster-cli-roguelike'. 6. Agent uses the proprietary phrasing 'reduces casual source visibility' when describing binaries — must NOT say 'impossible to reverse engineer'. 7. Agent must NOT include any 'git clone' instruction. All of this must be written into a file named player_guide.md.
